gallery.title: File:Locomotion (1925 cavalcade).jpg
gallery.description:
Locomotion No 1 of the Stockton & Darlington Railway at their 1925 100th anniversary cavalcade.

Note that the 100 year old locomotive is indeed hauling the train, although it is actually propelled by a small petrol engine in its replica tender and the chimney smoke is from burning oily rags for effect!
categories: Postcards of steam locomotives in the United Kingdom

gallery.title: File:Bowersfield Conservation (view NW) - geograph.org.uk - 1713315.jpg
gallery.description: Bowersfield Conservation  (view NW) This photograph shows a view of a section of the Bowesfield Conservation area which lies just to the west of the River Tees near The Holmes. The picture was taken looking in a north westerly direction towards the Bowesfield Industrial Estate.  The land beyond the conservation area is undergoing rapid commercial development.

gallery.description: Bowersfield Conservation  (view SE) This photograph shows a view of a section of the Bowesfield Conservation area which lies just to the west of the River Tees near The Holmes. The picture was taken looking in a south-easterly direction towards Thornaby-on-Tees.  Some of the houses on the other side of the river can just be seen in the horizon.
